scope: Proposition 8.2 (Retained-anchor travel) of the manuscript “Squared-logarithmic randomized k-server on arbitrary metrics” (preprints/Squared-logarithmic-randomized-k-server-on-arbitrary-metrics-September-24-2026/Squared-logarithmic-randomized-k-server-on-arbitrary-metrics-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 110 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 db9f0de04f757cf3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 51. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is an absolute constant C and a finite constant Danchor, independent of the input law and horizon, such that Tanchor ≤ C ( V + ℓP + ℓQ ) + Danchor. (8.8) Consequently the expected cost of moving the new parked masses with their retained anchors is at most 40Tanchor. No multiplicative constant in this statement depends on the number of levels or on k.
